mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_report ( report_date, version, window_start, window_end, data_cutoff_at, snapshot_json ) VALUES ( #{reportDate}, #{version}, #{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{dataCutoffAt}, #{snapshotJson} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_date, version, window_start, window_end, data_cutoff_at, snapshot_json, created_at FROM daily_report WHERE report_date = #{reportDate} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
